results.title: General accessibility question, not a trip request

turns.user: Does BART have wheelchair access at every station?
turns.message:
Yes — every BART station is wheelchair accessible. All stations have elevators and wider accessible fare gates (usually located nearest the elevators), and all trains have level boarding with designated wheelchair areas and priority seating.

One practical note: at a few stations the elevator doesn't let out at a staffed fare gate, so if you can't process your ticket there, see a ticket agent for help.

If you'd like, tell me where you're starting from and where you're headed, and I can look at door-to-door ride options too.
